# ⌘Y: the files and web pages on screen, in order and each once, folders
# left out (a probe shows no panel: it keeps what the panel would list);
# ⇧⌘-click previews just the one. tests/run.sh writes @DIR@'s files and
# `list`, the lines printed here.
type:cd @DIR@ && cat list
key:enter
wait:1.0
action:quick_look
expect-quick-look:shot.png | notes.txt | https://example.com/a
quick-look-click:notes.txt
expect-quick-look:notes.txt
